Description: Infection of susceptible individuals at the force of infection lambda_i.
Vaccination of susceptible individuals who will become protected, occurring at rate e_i * n(t).
Vaccination of susceptible individuals who will not become protected, occurring at rate (1-e_i) * n(t).
Development of protection in effectively vaccinated individuals at rate gamma.
Infection of effectively vaccinated but not yet protected individuals at the force of infection lambda_i.
Infection of ineffectively vaccinated individuals at the force of infection lambda_i.
Progression from latent to infectious state at rate k.

Name: k
Description: Rate of progression from latent to infectious state.

Name: c_1
Description: Recovery rate for infectious class.

Name: c_2
Description: Recovery rate for hospitalized class.

Name: g
Description: Rate at which effectively vaccinated individuals become protected (mean of 10 days).

Name: e_i
Description: Age-specific vaccine efficacy.

Name: n(t)
Description: Vaccination rate, administered t* days after epidemic onset.

Name: q
Description: Transmission probability per contact.

Name: c_ij
Description: Age-specific contact rates.

Name: b_ij
Description: Transmission rate between age groups i and j.

Name: p_Hi
Description: Fraction of clinical cases that are hospitalized for age group i.

Name: CFP_i
Description: Case fatality proportion (probability of death following hospitalization) for age group i.

Name: a_i
Description: Age-specific hospitalization rate for infectious individuals.

Name: d_i
Description: Age-specific influenza mortality rate for hospitalized individuals.
